description: Machine-readable catalog of the tools a grab-mcp server exposes. Each entry maps 1:1 to a grab CLI verb. `safety` distinguishes read-only observation from input synthesis that mutates the live desktop; a server MAY gate the input-synthesis group behind an allowlist or a --read-only flag. Field `cli` is the underlying command a stdio server shells out to.

tools.name: doctor
tools.title: Environment & capability report
tools.description: Report the available display, backends, and capabilities as JSON. Call first to confirm the desktop session is reachable before other tools.

display.description: X display to probe, e.g. ":0" or ":99". Defaults to $DISPLAY.

tools.name: list_windows
tools.title: Enumerate top-level windows
tools.description: List every mapped top-level window with its native id, WM_CLASS, title, EWMH type, pid, and screen-coordinate bounds. Use this to resolve the id/class needed by capture_screen, focus_window, place_window, and key.

wm_class.description: Filter to windows whose WM_CLASS contains this substring (case-insensitive).

type.description: Filter by EWMH window type, e.g. "normal", "dialog", "utility".

tools.name: capture_screen
tools.title: Screenshot a window or region
tools.description: Capture a window (by WM_CLASS match or native id), a screen region, or an output to a PNG file. Focus-safe: capturing does not steal focus. Returns the path written.

window.description: Capture the window whose WM_CLASS matches this substring.

window_id.description: Capture the window with this native id (e.g. "0x1e00007"), as reported by list_windows.

region.description: Capture a region "x,y,width,height" in screen coordinates.

tools.name: compare_images
tools.title: Compare two images
tools.description: Compare two PNG images and report whether they match plus an RMSE metric. Useful for visual regression checks after a mutating step.

actual.description: Path to the image to check.

tools.name: watch_events
tools.title: Observe desktop events
tools.description: Observe keyboard, mouse, focus, and window events, optionally scoped to a window. Long-running; a server should stream or bound the run with a duration.

window.description: Scope events to the window whose WM_CLASS matches this substring.

tools.name: batch
tools.title: Run a batch manifest
tools.description: Run a JSON/manifest-driven batch of capture/compare operations. Read-only with respect to the desktop.

tools.name: focus_window
tools.title: Raise and focus a window
tools.description: Raise and focus a window by WM_CLASS substring or native id. Idempotent: converges on the same end state. Activation is a request to the window manager and may be asynchronous.

window.description: Focus the window whose WM_CLASS matches this substring.

window_id.description: Focus the window with this native id.

tools.name: place_window
tools.title: Move and resize a window
tools.description: Drive a window to exact position and size and poll until it has held that geometry. Clears maximised/fullscreen state first. Idempotent.

window_id.description: Native id of the window to place.

window.description: WM_CLASS substring of the window to place.

tools.name: click
tools.title: Click the mouse
tools.description: Click at screen coordinates or at a resolved UI locator. Moves the real pointer — do not call speculatively; capture_screen first to confirm the target.

tools.name: type_text
tools.title: Type text
tools.description: Type a string into the currently focused surface as real keystrokes. Focus the intended window first (focus_window).

tools.name: key
tools.title: Send a keystroke
tools.description: Send a key chord (e.g. "ctrl+s", "alt+Tab") to a window by id, or to the focused surface.

window_id.description: Target window native id. Defaults to the focused surface.

tools.name: drag
tools.title: Drag the mouse
tools.description: Press, move, and release between two screen points. Use drag_curve for gesture/curved drags.
